name: Create source references by field name
description: Recognize and create source references by field name
statement:
/*
Recognize and create source references by field name
*/

INSERT INTO CFG.SOURCE_REFERENCES(CardinalityTypeID, JoinTypeID, Source1ID, Source2ID, Description)
SELECT 3,3,Source1ID, Source2ID, 'FK_' + Source_Name1 + '_' + Source_Name2
FROM
(

	SELECT 
		Source1ID = PK.SourceID, 
		SourceColumn1ID = PK.SourceColumnID, 
		Source_Name1 = PK.Source_Name,
		Column_Name1 = PK.Column_Name,
		cnt1 = PK.cnt, 
		Source2ID = SC.SourceID,
		Source_Name2 = S.Source_Name,
		Column_Name2 = SC.Column_Name,
		SourceColumn2ID = SC.SourceColumnID, 
		cnt2 = COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PK.SourceID, SC.SourceID),
		isPK2 = CASE WHEN SC.PK_Ordinal_Position IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	FROM
		(
			SELECT 
				S.SourceID, 
				S.Source_Name,
				SC.SourceColumnID, 
				SC.Column_Name, 
				SC.PK_Ordinal_Position, 
				cnt = COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY S.SourceID)
			FROM 
				CFG.SOURCES S
				INNER JOIN CFG.SOURCE_COLUMNS SC ON
					SC.SourceID = S.SourceID AND
					SC.PK_Ordinal_Position IS NOT NULL
			WHERE
				S.ConnectorID = :1
		) PK
		INNER JOIN CFG.SOURCE_COLUMNS SC ON		
			SC.SourceID != PK.SourceID AND
			SC.Column_Name = PK.Column_Name
		INNER JOIN CFG.SOURCES S ON
			S.SourceID = SC.SourceID AND
			S.ConnectorID = :1
) T
WHERE
	cnt1 = cnt2 AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CFG.SOURCE_REFERENCES SR WHERE SR.Source1ID = T.Source1ID AND SR.Source2ID = T.Source2ID)
GROUP BY
	Source1ID, Source2ID, Source_Name1, Source_Name2
HAVING
	SUM(isPK2) <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CFG.SOURCE_COLUMNS SC1 WHERE SC1.SourceID = Source2ID AND PK_Ordinal_Position IS NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO CFG.SOURCE_REFERENCE_COLUMNS(SourceRefID, SourceColumn1ID, SourceColumn2ID)
SELECT SR.SourceRefID, T.SourceColumn1ID, T.SourceColumn2ID
FROM
(

	SELECT 
		Source1ID = PK.SourceID, 
		SourceColumn1ID = PK.SourceColumnID, 
		Source_Name1 = PK.Source_Name,
		Column_Name1 = PK.Column_Name,
		cnt1 = PK.cnt, 
		Source2ID = SC.SourceID,
		Source_Name2 = S.Source_Name,
		Column_Name2 = SC.Column_Name,
		SourceColumn2ID = SC.SourceColumnID, 
		cnt2 = COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PK.SourceID, SC.SourceID)
	FROM
		(
			SELECT 
				S.SourceID, 
				S.Source_Name,
				SC.SourceColumnID, 
				SC.Column_Name, 
				SC.PK_Ordinal_Position, 
				cnt = COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY S.SourceID)
			FROM 
				CFG.SOURCES S
				INNER JOIN CFG.SOURCE_COLUMNS SC ON
					SC.SourceID = S.SourceID AND
					SC.PK_Ordinal_Position IS NOT NULL
			WHERE
				S.ConnectorID = :1
		) PK
		INNER JOIN CFG.SOURCE_COLUMNS SC ON		
			SC.SourceID != PK.SourceID AND
			SC.Column_Name = PK.Column_Name
		INNER JOIN CFG.SOURCES S ON
			S.SourceID = SC.SourceID AND
			S.ConnectorID = :1
) T
INNER JOIN CFG.SOURCE_REFERENCES SR ON
	SR.Source1ID = T.Source1ID AND
	SR.Source2ID = T.Source2ID AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CFG.SOURCE_REFERENCE_COLUMNS SRC WHERE SRC.SourceRefID = SR.SourceRefID)
WHERE
	T.cnt1 = T.cnt2
